name: optiscaler
description: firehoooo's second box: OptiScaler 0.9.4 as the D3D12 proxy, RTSS running, no ReShade, the mod pinned to 1.2.0 — the build whose discovery swapchain crashes in it

report.thread: Nexus, following his 1.1.1 E_ABORT report a day earlier
report.verdict: 3/3 crash at 11-17 s on this box, with frame generation on AND off; cause was the mod's throwaway discovery swapchain, fixed by 71963f6

payloads.note: OptiScaler.dll from the official v0.9.4 release, renamed — this is how it loads, as the D3D12 proxy
the nine libraries the recipe names, 174 MB. The game ships its OWN amd_fidelityfx_dx12.dll in Win64 and it is not touched — the subfolder is what keeps the two apart

the vendor's own ini with seven keys set on the lines it already had for them: OptiDllPath=.\OptiScaler\, Dx12Upscaler=xess, [FrameGen] Enabled=true FGInput=dlssg FGOutput=fsrfg, LogToFile=true, LogLevel=2. OptiScaler rewrites it while it runs
he had no ReShade in this configuration; this box's proxy comes off

expect.note: OptiScaler loads AS d3d12.dll, so that is the module this configuration is recognised by, and this box's own ReShade proxy must be gone from it. Modules are matched on the END of the loaded module's full path.

manual.rtss: RTSS 7.3.5 here, 7.3.7 in the report. The SCRIPT never starts or stops it - it reads it back and refuses. Starting it from its own exe needs no elevation; STOPPING it does, so an ordinary shell cannot, and it is closed from its tray icon.
manual.driver_vsync: the owner's word — not readable from a script
manual.monitors: three: 1920x1080 @ 75 Hz primary, 1920x1080 @ 100 Hz, 1080x1920 @ 75 Hz rotated; the game runs on the primary
